title: VesMod: Vesicle contour extraction and flicker spectroscopy
description:
Installation instructions and documentation: Visit the VesMod GitHub repository.

This Zenodo record preserves an archived release of VesMod. VesMod is a Python package for extracting membrane contours from microscopy videos of giant unilamellar vesicles and estimating membrane bending rigidity from thermal shape fluctuations.
